summary: Frontend-only Playwright E2E of Lechrol WZ SPA (localStorage mode). All 24 scenarios in the review request passed: sidebar/nav visibility, empty state, editor open with default date/place, live number preview with contractor code, Enter-adds-row & X-removes-row & Dodaj pozycję, save validation, save success toast+title switch to 'Edycja WZ ...', save-contractor checkbox adds contractor, docs list count/search, sequence increment same-month (8001->8002 seq), keeps number on edit, Kontrahenci CRUD (validation, add, Kod first+last letter uppercase e.g. 'Beta Corp'->'BP', search), Ustawienia defaults (ZPHU Lechrol..., Łomianki), save toast, place propagates to new WZ, theme toggle -> data-theme='dark' persists after reload, full localStorage persistence after reload (docs=2 restored), Zapisz PDF fills #print-area (4299 chars, contains contractor name) & calls window.print(), Wyślij e-mailem shows 'Wysyłka e-mail dostępna tylko w aplikacji desktopowej.', delete confirm dialog + toast 'Usunięto dokument ...'.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In lib/printing.ts savePdfDocument browser fallback calls window.print(); during our test print() was observed to fire twice for one click — likely React StrictMode double-invocation in dev only (harmless in production build). Consider guarding if it causes double print dialogs in real Electron builds.
storage.ts deepMerge: safe usage; DEFAULT_STATE is exported and used both in App and storage — consider single source of truth (already fine).
EditorView collectItems filters items with name OR qty — a row with only qty (no name) still gets saved. Acceptable per original spec but worth confirming with product.
No data-testid on individual doc-print/doc-pdf/doc-email buttons in the docs list actually already present via `doc-print-<id>` etc — good.
seed_data_creation: Test created via UI: 2 documents (8001/RA/2026 Rolety Siejka, 8002/AA/2026 Alicja Bartoszewska) and 2 contractors (Rolety Siejka, Beta Corp). Persisted in localStorage key 'lechrol-wz-data'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully SPA + localStorage; window.wzApi undefined so hasApi=false path exercised. All data-testids listed in review are present and functional. Backend (FastAPI boilerplate) is unused — do not test. Delete/email flows use window.confirm — attach a dialog handler before clicking. window.print must be stubbed to avoid opening print dialog during headless test.
